import { ArrowLeft, Clock3 } from 'lucide-react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown'
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm'
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { tsParticles } from '@tsparticles/engine'
import { loadSlim } from '@tsparticles/slim'
import { ExpandableSection } from '../components/primitives/ExpandableSection'
import { DifficultyBadge } from '../components/primitives/DifficultyBadge'
import { TaskNav } from '../components/composite/TaskNav'
import { TaskSection } from '../components/composite/TaskSection'
import { ResourceList } from '../components/composite/ResourceList'
import { SubmissionGuidelinesCard } from '../components/composite/SubmissionGuidelinesCard'
import { SubmissionPanel } from '../components/composite/SubmissionPanel'
import spidermanTaskTwoImage from '../assets/spiderman_task_2_elec.jpg'
import { getTaskById, getVerticalById, getTasksForVertical } from '../lib/data'
import { accentColors } from '../theme/tokens'
import { taskThemes } from '../theme/taskThemes'
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

export function TaskDetailPage() {
  const { id = '', taskId = '' } = useParams()
  const isElectricalTaskTwo = taskId === 'elec-02'
  const pageRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const heroImageRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null)
  const heroWebRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isElectricalTaskTwo) {
      return
    }

    const page = pageRef.current
    const content = contentRef.current
    const image = heroImageRef.current
    const web = heroWebRef.current
    if (!page || !content || !image || !web) return

    let particleContainer: { destroy: () => void } | undefined
    let isMounted = true
    let impactRing: HTMLElement | null = null
    const cardHandlers: Array<{ card: HTMLElement; onMove: (event: PointerEvent) => void; onLeave: () => void }> = []
    const lenis = new Lenis({ duration: 1.1, smoothWheel: true })
    lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
    const lenisRaf = (time: number) => lenis.raf(time * 1000)
    gsap.ticker.add(lenisRaf)
    gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      const hero = page.querySelector('.task-detail-header')
      const sections = gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('.task-section')
      const progress = page.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.task2-scroll-progress')
      const cta = page.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.submission-panel .primary-button')
      const cards = gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('.task-section, .resource-card, .submission-panel')

      gsap.set(web, { strokeDasharray: 620, strokeDashoffset: 620 })
      const heroTimeline = gsap.timeline({
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: hero, start: 'top top', end: '+=620', scrub: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
      })
      heroTimeline
        .fromTo(image, { xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0, rotation: 0 }, { xPercent: 0, yPercent: -7, rotation: -1, ease: 'none' }, 0)
        .to(web, { strokeDashoffset: 0, ease: 'none' }, 0.08)
        .fromTo('.task2-hero-kicker', { x: -24, opacity: 0 }, { x: 0, opacity: 1, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0.18)

      sections.forEach((section) => {
        gsap.fromTo(section, { y: 42, opacity: 0 }, {
          y: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: 0.8,
          ease: 'power3.out',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: section, start: 'top 86%', toggleActions: 'play reverse play reverse' },
        })
        gsap.fromTo(section.querySelector('.section-tag-badge'), { x: -10, opacity: 0 }, {
          x: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: 0.5,
          ease: 'power2.out',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: section, start: 'top 82%', toggleActions: 'play reverse play reverse' },
        })
      })

      if (progress) {
        gsap.to(progress, {
          scaleY: 1,
          ease: 'none',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: page, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom bottom', scrub: true },
        })
      }

      const magneticX = cta ? gsap.quickTo(cta, 'x', { duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out' }) : null
      const magneticY = cta ? gsap.quickTo(cta, 'y', { duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out' }) : null
      impactRing = cta ? document.createElement('span') : null
      if (impactRing) {
        impactRing.className = 'task2-impact-ring'
        impactRing.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
        cta?.appendChild(impactRing)
      }
      const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!cta || !magneticX || !magneticY) return
        const bounds = cta.getBoundingClientRect()
        magneticX((event.clientX - bounds.left - bounds.width / 2) * 0.12)
        magneticY((event.clientY - bounds.top - bounds.height / 2) * 0.12)
        cta.style.setProperty('--pointer-x', `${event.clientX - bounds.left}px`)
        cta.style.setProperty('--pointer-y', `${event.clientY - bounds.top}px`)
      }
      const onPointerLeave = () => {
        magneticX?.(0)
        magneticY?.(0)
      }
      const onClick = () => {
        const ring = cta?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.task2-impact-ring')
        if (ring) gsap.fromTo(ring, { scale: 0.2, opacity: 0.75 }, { scale: 2.4, opacity: 0, duration: 0.65, ease: 'power2.out' })
      }

      cta?.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove)
      cta?.addEventListener('pointerleave', onPointerLeave)
      cta?.addEventListener('click', onClick)

      cards.forEach((card, index) => {
        const onMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
          const bounds = card.getBoundingClientRect()
          const x = (event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width - 0.5
          const y = (event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height - 0.5
          gsap.to(card, { rotateY: x * 3.5, rotateX: y * -3.5, transformPerspective: 900, duration: 0.35, overwrite: true })
        }
        const onLeave = () => gsap.to(card, { rotateY: 0, rotateX: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power3.out', overwrite: true })
        card.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
        card.addEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave)
        cardHandlers.push({ card, onMove, onLeave })
        gsap.set(card, { transformOrigin: index % 2 ? '60% 50%' : '40% 50%' })
      })

      void (async () => {
        await loadSlim(tsParticles)
        if (!isMounted) return
        particleContainer = await tsParticles.load({
          id: 'task2-particles',
          options: {
            fullScreen: { enable: false },
            particles: { number: { value: 28 }, color: { value: '#E62429' }, opacity: { value: { min: 0.15, max: 0.45 } }, size: { value: { min: 1, max: 2.5 } }, move: { enable: true, speed: 0.45, direction: 'top', outModes: { default: 'out' } }, links: { enable: false } },
            detectRetina: true,
          },
        })
      })()
    }, page)

    return () => {
      isMounted = false
      particleContainer?.destroy()
      lenis.destroy()
      gsap.ticker.remove(lenisRaf)
      cardHandlers.forEach(({ card, onMove, onLeave }) => {
        card.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
        card.removeEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave)
      })
      impactRing?.remove()
      ctx.revert()
    }
  }, [isElectricalTaskTwo])

  const task = getTaskById(taskId)
  const vertical = getVerticalById(id)

  if (!task || !vertical || task.verticalId !== vertical.id) {
    return (
      <section className="empty-state">
        <span className="section-tag-badge">TASK NOT FOUND</span>
        <h1>Task not found.</h1>
        <p>That task does not belong to the selected vertical.</p>
        <Link className="primary-button" to="/verticals">
          <ArrowLeft size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> Back to verticals
        </Link>
      </section>
    )
  }

  const verticalTasks = getTasksForVertical(vertical.id)
  const taskIndex = verticalTasks.findIndex((verticalTask) => verticalTask.id === task.id)
  const theme = isElectricalTaskTwo ? taskThemes.electricalTaskTwo : taskThemes[vertical.id]

  return (
    <article
      ref={pageRef}
      className={theme ? `task-detail-page ${theme.className}` : 'task-detail-page'}
      style={{ '--vertical-accent': accentColors[vertical.accentColor] } as CSSProperties}
    >
      {isElectricalTaskTwo && <><div id="task2-particles" className="task2-particles" aria-hidden="true" /><div className="task2-scroll-progress" aria-hidden="true" /></>}
      <nav className="breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
        <Link to="/verticals">Verticals</Link>
        <span className="breadcrumb-separator">/</span>
        <Link to={`/verticals/${vertical.id}`}>{vertical.name}</Link>
        <span className="breadcrumb-separator">/</span>
        <span className="breadcrumb-current" aria-current="page">
          {task.title}
        </span>
      </nav>

      <header className="task-detail-header" aria-label={theme?.imageAlt}>
        {isElectricalTaskTwo && <span className="task2-hero-kicker">WEB-SLINGER CIRCUIT DIVISION</span>}
        {isElectricalTaskTwo && <svg className="task2-hero-web" viewBox="0 0 620 360" aria-hidden="true"><path ref={heroWebRef} d="M614 4 C520 42 508 110 452 136 S310 162 232 224 S116 306 8 356" /></svg>}
        {isElectricalTaskTwo && (
          <img
            ref={heroImageRef}
            className="task2-hero-image"
            src={spidermanTaskTwoImage}
            alt={theme.imageAlt}
          />
        )}
        <div className="task-detail-badges" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem', marginBottom: '0.65rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <span className="track-pill">{vertical.name}</span>
          <span className="section-tag-badge">{task.id.toUpperCase()}</span>
          {theme && (
            <span className="theme-tagline-pill">
              <span aria-hidden="true">{theme.icon}</span>
              {theme.tagline}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="task-deadline">Due: {task.deadline}</span>
        <h1>{task.title}</h1>
        <p>{task.shortDescription}</p>

        <div className="task-detail-meta">
          <DifficultyBadge difficulty={task.difficulty} />
          <span className="time-estimate">
            <Clock3 size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            Estimated: ~{task.estimatedTime}
          </span>
          {task.prerequisites.map((prerequisite) => (
            <span className="tag-chip" key={prerequisite}>
              {prerequisite}
            </span>
          ))}
          {task.tags.map((tag) => (
            <span className="tag-chip" key={tag}>
              #{tag}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="task-detail-content" ref={contentRef}>
        <TaskSection label="PROBLEM STATEMENT">
          <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]} components={{ a: (props) => <a href={props.href} title={props.title} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{props.children}</a> }}>{task.instructions}</ReactMarkdown>
        </TaskSection>

        {task.prerequisites.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="PREREQUISITES">
            <ul>
              {task.prerequisites.map((prerequisite) => (
                <li key={prerequisite}>{prerequisite}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        {task.evaluationCriteria.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="EVALUATION CRITERIA">
            <ul className="criteria-list">
              {task.evaluationCriteria.map((criterion) => (
                <li key={criterion}>
                  <span className="criteria-checkbox" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
                  <span>{criterion}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        {task.resources.required.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="REQUIRED RESOURCES">
            <ResourceList resources={task.resources.required} />
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        {task.resources.optional.length > 0 && (
          <ExpandableSection label="Want to go further? (Optional Resources)">
            <ResourceList resources={task.resources.optional} />
          </ExpandableSection>
        )}

        {task.contactdetails.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="CONTACT DETAILS">
            <ul>
              {task.contactdetails.map((contactDetail) => (
                <li key={contactDetail}>{contactDetail}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        <SubmissionGuidelinesCard verticalId={vertical.id} taskNumber={task.taskNumber} />
        <SubmissionPanel task={task} verticalName={vertical.name} />
      </div>

      <TaskNav
        verticalId={vertical.id}
        previous={taskIndex > 0 ? verticalTasks[taskIndex - 1] : undefined}
        next={taskIndex < verticalTasks.length - 1 ? verticalTasks[taskIndex + 1] : undefined}
      />
    </article>
  )
}

import { ArrowLeft, Clock3 } from 'lucide-react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import Lenis from '@studio-freight/lenis'
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown'
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm'
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { tsParticles } from '@tsparticles/engine'
import { loadSlim } from '@tsparticles/slim'
import { ExpandableSection } from '../components/primitives/ExpandableSection'
import { DifficultyBadge } from '../components/primitives/DifficultyBadge'
import { TaskNav } from '../components/composite/TaskNav'
import { TaskSection } from '../components/composite/TaskSection'
import { ResourceList } from '../components/composite/ResourceList'
import { SubmissionGuidelinesCard } from '../components/composite/SubmissionGuidelinesCard'
import { SubmissionPanel } from '../components/composite/SubmissionPanel'
import spidermanTaskTwoImage from '../assets/spiderman_task_2_elec.jpg'
import { getTaskById, getVerticalById, getTasksForVertical } from '../lib/data'
import { accentColors } from '../theme/tokens'
import { taskThemes } from '../theme/taskThemes'
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)

export function TaskDetailPage() {
  const { id = '', taskId = '' } = useParams()
  const isElectricalTaskTwo = taskId === 'elec-02'
  const pageRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const heroImageRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null)
  const heroWebRef = useRef<SVGPathElement>(null)
  const pcbRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isElectricalTaskTwo) {
      return
    }

    const page = pageRef.current
    const content = contentRef.current
    const image = heroImageRef.current
    const web = heroWebRef.current
    const pcb = pcbRef.current
    if (!page || !content || !image || !web || !pcb) return

    let particleContainer: { destroy: () => void } | undefined
    let isMounted = true
    let impactRing: HTMLElement | null = null
    const cardHandlers: Array<{ card: HTMLElement; onMove: (event: PointerEvent) => void; onLeave: () => void }> = []
    const lenis = new Lenis({ duration: 1.1, smoothWheel: true })
    lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
    const lenisRaf = (time: number) => lenis.raf(time * 1000)
    gsap.ticker.add(lenisRaf)
    gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)

    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      const hero = page.querySelector('.task-detail-header')
      const sections = gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('.task-section')
      const progress = page.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.task2-scroll-progress')
      const cta = page.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.submission-panel .primary-button')
      const cards = gsap.utils.toArray<HTMLElement>('.task-section, .resource-card, .submission-panel')
      const pcbTraces = gsap.utils.toArray<SVGPathElement>('.task2-pcb-trace')

      pcbTraces.forEach((trace, index) => {
        const length = trace.getTotalLength()
        gsap.set(trace, { strokeDasharray: `${length * 0.12} ${length * 0.88}`, strokeDashoffset: length })
        gsap.to(trace, {
          strokeDashoffset: -length,
          duration: 4.6 + index * 0.55,
          repeat: -1,
          ease: 'none',
          delay: index * 0.32,
        })
      })

      gsap.set(web, { strokeDasharray: 620, strokeDashoffset: 620 })
      const heroTimeline = gsap.timeline({
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: hero, start: 'top top', end: '+=620', scrub: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
      })
      heroTimeline
        .fromTo(image, { xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0, rotation: 0 }, { xPercent: 0, yPercent: -7, rotation: -1, ease: 'none' }, 0)
        .to(web, { strokeDashoffset: 0, ease: 'none' }, 0.08)
        .fromTo('.task2-hero-kicker', { x: -24, opacity: 0 }, { x: 0, opacity: 1, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0.18)

      sections.forEach((section) => {
        gsap.fromTo(section, { y: 42, opacity: 0 }, {
          y: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: 0.8,
          ease: 'power3.out',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: section, start: 'top 86%', toggleActions: 'play reverse play reverse' },
        })
        gsap.fromTo(section.querySelector('.section-tag-badge'), { x: -10, opacity: 0 }, {
          x: 0,
          opacity: 1,
          duration: 0.5,
          ease: 'power2.out',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: section, start: 'top 82%', toggleActions: 'play reverse play reverse' },
        })
      })

      if (progress) {
        gsap.to(progress, {
          scaleY: 1,
          ease: 'none',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: page, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom bottom', scrub: true },
        })
      }

      const magneticX = cta ? gsap.quickTo(cta, 'x', { duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out' }) : null
      const magneticY = cta ? gsap.quickTo(cta, 'y', { duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out' }) : null
      impactRing = cta ? document.createElement('span') : null
      if (impactRing) {
        impactRing.className = 'task2-impact-ring'
        impactRing.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
        cta?.appendChild(impactRing)
      }
      const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
        if (!cta || !magneticX || !magneticY) return
        const bounds = cta.getBoundingClientRect()
        magneticX((event.clientX - bounds.left - bounds.width / 2) * 0.12)
        magneticY((event.clientY - bounds.top - bounds.height / 2) * 0.12)
        cta.style.setProperty('--pointer-x', `${event.clientX - bounds.left}px`)
        cta.style.setProperty('--pointer-y', `${event.clientY - bounds.top}px`)
      }
      const onPointerLeave = () => {
        magneticX?.(0)
        magneticY?.(0)
      }
      const onClick = () => {
        const ring = cta?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.task2-impact-ring')
        if (ring) gsap.fromTo(ring, { scale: 0.2, opacity: 0.75 }, { scale: 2.4, opacity: 0, duration: 0.65, ease: 'power2.out' })
      }

      cta?.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove)
      cta?.addEventListener('pointerleave', onPointerLeave)
      cta?.addEventListener('click', onClick)

      cards.forEach((card, index) => {
        const onMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
          const bounds = card.getBoundingClientRect()
          const x = (event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width - 0.5
          const y = (event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height - 0.5
          gsap.to(card, { rotateY: x * 3.5, rotateX: y * -3.5, transformPerspective: 900, duration: 0.35, overwrite: true })
        }
        const onLeave = () => gsap.to(card, { rotateY: 0, rotateX: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power3.out', overwrite: true })
        card.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
        card.addEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave)
        cardHandlers.push({ card, onMove, onLeave })
        gsap.set(card, { transformOrigin: index % 2 ? '60% 50%' : '40% 50%' })
      })

      void (async () => {
        await loadSlim(tsParticles)
        if (!isMounted) return
        particleContainer = await tsParticles.load({
          id: 'task2-particles',
          options: {
            fullScreen: { enable: false },
            particles: { number: { value: 28 }, color: { value: '#E62429' }, opacity: { value: { min: 0.15, max: 0.45 } }, size: { value: { min: 1, max: 2.5 } }, move: { enable: true, speed: 0.45, direction: 'top', outModes: { default: 'out' } }, links: { enable: false } },
            detectRetina: true,
          },
        })
      })()
    }, page)

    return () => {
      isMounted = false
      particleContainer?.destroy()
      lenis.destroy()
      gsap.ticker.remove(lenisRaf)
      cardHandlers.forEach(({ card, onMove, onLeave }) => {
        card.removeEventListener('pointermove', onMove)
        card.removeEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave)
      })
      impactRing?.remove()
      ctx.revert()
    }
  }, [isElectricalTaskTwo])

  const task = getTaskById(taskId)
  const vertical = getVerticalById(id)

  if (!task || !vertical || task.verticalId !== vertical.id) {
    return (
      <section className="empty-state">
        <span className="section-tag-badge">TASK NOT FOUND</span>
        <h1>Task not found.</h1>
        <p>That task does not belong to the selected vertical.</p>
        <Link className="primary-button" to="/verticals">
          <ArrowLeft size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> Back to verticals
        </Link>
      </section>
    )
  }

  const verticalTasks = getTasksForVertical(vertical.id)
  const taskIndex = verticalTasks.findIndex((verticalTask) => verticalTask.id === task.id)
  const theme = isElectricalTaskTwo ? taskThemes.electricalTaskTwo : taskThemes[vertical.id]

  return (
    <article
      ref={pageRef}
      className={theme ? `task-detail-page ${theme.className}` : 'task-detail-page'}
      style={{ '--vertical-accent': accentColors[vertical.accentColor] } as CSSProperties}
    >
      {isElectricalTaskTwo && <><div id="task2-particles" className="task2-particles" aria-hidden="true" /><div className="task2-scroll-progress" aria-hidden="true" /></>}
      {isElectricalTaskTwo && (
        <svg ref={pcbRef} className="task2-pcb-layer" viewBox="0 0 1200 1800" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
          <path className="task2-pcb-base" d="M40 170 H300 V360 H520 V690 H770 V960 H1160 M1160 210 H930 V470 H680 V810 H420 V1240 H60 M80 1480 H280 V1320 H590 V1510 H1120" />
          <path className="task2-pcb-trace task2-pcb-trace-red" d="M40 170 H300 V360 H520 V690 H770 V960 H1160" />
          <path className="task2-pcb-trace task2-pcb-trace-blue" d="M1160 210 H930 V470 H680 V810 H420 V1240 H60" />
          <path className="task2-pcb-trace task2-pcb-trace-red" d="M80 1480 H280 V1320 H590 V1510 H1120" />
          <circle className="task2-pcb-node" cx="300" cy="170" r="5" /><circle className="task2-pcb-node" cx="770" cy="690" r="5" /><circle className="task2-pcb-node" cx="420" cy="1240" r="5" /><circle className="task2-pcb-node" cx="590" cy="1510" r="5" />
        </svg>
      )}
      <nav className="breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
        <Link to="/verticals">Verticals</Link>
        <span className="breadcrumb-separator">/</span>
        <Link to={`/verticals/${vertical.id}`}>{vertical.name}</Link>
        <span className="breadcrumb-separator">/</span>
        <span className="breadcrumb-current" aria-current="page">
          {task.title}
        </span>
      </nav>

      <header className="task-detail-header" aria-label={theme?.imageAlt}>
        {isElectricalTaskTwo && <span className="task2-hero-kicker">WEB-SLINGER CIRCUIT DIVISION</span>}
        {isElectricalTaskTwo && <svg className="task2-hero-web" viewBox="0 0 620 360" aria-hidden="true"><path ref={heroWebRef} d="M614 4 C520 42 508 110 452 136 S310 162 232 224 S116 306 8 356" /></svg>}
        {isElectricalTaskTwo && (
          <img
            ref={heroImageRef}
            className="task2-hero-image"
            src={spidermanTaskTwoImage}
            alt={theme.imageAlt}
          />
        )}
        <div className="task-detail-badges" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem', marginBottom: '0.65rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <span className="track-pill">{vertical.name}</span>
          <span className="section-tag-badge">{task.id.toUpperCase()}</span>
          {theme && (
            <span className="theme-tagline-pill">
              <span aria-hidden="true">{theme.icon}</span>
              {theme.tagline}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="task-deadline">Due: {task.deadline}</span>
        <h1>{task.title}</h1>
        <p>{task.shortDescription}</p>

        <div className="task-detail-meta">
          <DifficultyBadge difficulty={task.difficulty} />
          <span className="time-estimate">
            <Clock3 size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            Estimated: ~{task.estimatedTime}
          </span>
          {task.prerequisites.map((prerequisite) => (
            <span className="tag-chip" key={prerequisite}>
              {prerequisite}
            </span>
          ))}
          {task.tags.map((tag) => (
            <span className="tag-chip" key={tag}>
              #{tag}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="task-detail-content" ref={contentRef}>
        <TaskSection label="PROBLEM STATEMENT">
          <ReactMarkdown remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]} components={{ a: (props) => <a href={props.href} title={props.title} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">{props.children}</a> }}>{task.instructions}</ReactMarkdown>
        </TaskSection>

        {task.prerequisites.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="PREREQUISITES">
            <ul>
              {task.prerequisites.map((prerequisite) => (
                <li key={prerequisite}>{prerequisite}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        {task.evaluationCriteria.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="EVALUATION CRITERIA">
            <ul className="criteria-list">
              {task.evaluationCriteria.map((criterion) => (
                <li key={criterion}>
                  <span className="criteria-checkbox" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>
                  <span>{criterion}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        {task.resources.required.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="REQUIRED RESOURCES">
            <ResourceList resources={task.resources.required} />
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        {task.resources.optional.length > 0 && (
          <ExpandableSection label="Want to go further? (Optional Resources)">
            <ResourceList resources={task.resources.optional} />
          </ExpandableSection>
        )}

        {task.contactdetails.length > 0 && (
          <TaskSection label="CONTACT DETAILS">
            <ul>
              {task.contactdetails.map((contactDetail) => (
                <li key={contactDetail}>{contactDetail}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </TaskSection>
        )}

        <SubmissionGuidelinesCard verticalId={vertical.id} taskNumber={task.taskNumber} />
        <SubmissionPanel task={task} verticalName={vertical.name} />
      </div>

      <TaskNav
        verticalId={vertical.id}
        previous={taskIndex > 0 ? verticalTasks[taskIndex - 1] : undefined}
        next={taskIndex < verticalTasks.length - 1 ? verticalTasks[taskIndex + 1] : undefined}
      />
    </article>
  )
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ASME RECRUITMENT PORTAL — UNITREE / ROBOX INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT THEME
   Fancy Animated Navbar, Smooth Parallax Stage, Clean Typography & Spacing
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   App Shell & Page Container
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-shell {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--color-background);
  color: var(--color-text);
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.app-shell::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.16;
  background-image: url('./assets/image.png');
  background-size: 100% auto;
  background-position: center top;
  background-repeat: repeat-y;
  filter: brightness(1.45) saturate(0.8) contrast(0.85);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .app-shell::before {
  opacity: 0.72;
  filter: brightness(0.72) saturate(1.1) contrast(1.05);
}

.page-content {
  flex: 1;
  width: min(100% - 3rem, 78rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 0 6rem;
  position: relative;
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .page-content > :not(.task-detail-page) {
  --color-surface: #111111;
  --color-surface-hover: #1c1c1c;
  --color-surface-subtle: #181818;
  --color-surface-card: #111111;
  --color-text: #ffffff;
  --color-text-secondary: #e4e4e7;
  --color-text-muted: #a1a1aa;
  --color-text-subtle: #71717a;
  --color-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --color-border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --color-border-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  --color-border-strong: #ffffff;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Typography Badges & Micro Labels (Clean, No '//' Slashes)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.section-tag-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
  width: fit-content;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
}

.hero-eyebrow-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.95rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Buttons & Micro-interactions
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.primary-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.75rem;
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-text);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

.primary-button:hover {
  background-color: #262626;
  border-color: #262626;
  color: #ffffff;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.primary-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.secondary-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.65rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.secondary-button:hover {
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
  color: #000000;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}

.text-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.text-link:hover {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.text-link svg {
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.text-link:hover svg {
  transform: translate(2px, -2px);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Fancy Animated Floating Capsule Navigation
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.site-header-wrapper {
  position: sticky;
  top: 1.25rem;
  z-index: 1000;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.site-header-wrapper.is-scrolled {
  top: 0.75rem;
}

.site-header-capsule {
  pointer-events: auto;
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  height: 56px;
  background-color: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.94);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.site-header-wrapper.is-scrolled .site-header-capsule {
  height: 50px;
  max-width: 48rem;
  background-color: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 45px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
}

.capsule-glow-border {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), rgba(255,255,255,0.25), rgba(255,255,255,0.08));
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.6;
  mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
}

.nav-group-left,
.nav-group-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  flex: 1;
}

.nav-group-right {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.capsule-brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0 1.25rem;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), opacity var(--transition-fast);
}

.capsule-brand-mark {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top center;
}

.capsule-brand:hover {
  transform: scale(1.03);
  opacity: 0.95;
}

.brand-badge-year {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #a1a1aa;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
}

.capsule-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 2.15rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #a1a1aa;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.capsule-link:hover {
  color: #ffffff;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.capsule-link.is-active {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.capsule-cta-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 2.15rem;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #000000;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.capsule-cta-pill:hover {
  background-color: #e4e4e7;
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

.theme-toggle-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  min-height: 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  color: #ffffff;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.theme-toggle-button:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.mobile-menu-drawer .theme-toggle-button {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  min-height: 44px;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: #a1a1aa;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.mobile-menu-drawer .theme-toggle-button:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: #ffffff;
  transform: none;
}

.menu-button {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Mobile Nav Drawer */
@media (max-width: 52rem) {
  .menu-button {
    display: inline-flex;
  }

  .nav-group-left,
  .nav-group-right {
    display: none;
  }

  .site-header-capsule {
    padding: 0 1.25rem;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .mobile-menu-drawer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 64px;
    left: 1.5rem;
    right: 1.5rem;
    background-color: #111111;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.85rem;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    pointer-events: auto;
    animation: drawer-fade-in 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }

  @keyframes drawer-fade-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  .mobile-menu-drawer .capsule-link {
    min-height: 44px;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  }

  .mobile-menu-drawer .capsule-link:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Hero Hardware Stage with Scroll Parallax Motion
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.hero-hardware-section {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2rem;
}

.hero-top-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.hero-title-main {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.5vw, 6.4rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 0.95;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  color: var(--color-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0;
}

.hero-subtitle-box {
  max-width: 25rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.hero-subtitle-box p {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.hero-actions-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* Main Studio Stage */
.hardware-stage {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--color-stage-bg);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 35px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease-out;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
}

.stage-light-ambient {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 70%;
  height: 40%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.stage-image {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  max-height: 640px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease-out;
}

/* Floating Spec Card (Continuous Levitation Motion) */
.floating-spec-card {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 2.5rem;
  right: 2.5rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.75rem 2rem;
  max-width: 330px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  z-index: 10;
  animation: floatCard 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes floatCard {
  0% {
    transform: translateY(0px);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }
}

.spec-icon-badge {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.floating-spec-card h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--color-text);
  margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
}

.floating-spec-card p {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 52rem) {
  .hero-top-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .floating-spec-card {
    position: static;
    margin: 1.25rem;
    max-width: none;
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Recruitment Stats Strip
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.stats-section {
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
}

.section-heading {
  margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
}

.section-heading h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.8vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.section-heading-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.stats-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.stat-block {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2rem 1.75rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.stat-block:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.stat-header-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.stat-index-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.stat-label-text {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--color-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.stat-block strong {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.95rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-text);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.stat-sub {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Vertical Cards (Physical Hardware Cards)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.vertical-preview-section {
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
}

.vertical-preview-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1.75rem;
}

.vertical-selection-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 2rem;
}

.vertical-card {
  --vertical-accent: var(--color-steel);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.vertical-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.vertical-card-media {
  width: 100%;
  height: 220px;
  background-color: var(--color-surface-subtle);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.vertical-card-media img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.vertical-card:hover .vertical-card-media img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.vertical-card-body {
  padding: 1.85rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}

.card-topline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.95rem;
}

.track-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

.vertical-card h2,
.vertical-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.vertical-card p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
}

.card-deliverables {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding-top: 1.25rem;
}

.card-deliverables .section-tag-badge {
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
}

.card-deliverables ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.card-deliverables li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.card-deliverables li::before {
  content: '✓';
  color: #10b981;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.vertical-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 1.35rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

.background-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.card-action-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.vertical-card:hover .card-action-btn {
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

/* Compact mode for Landing Page */
.vertical-card-compact .vertical-card-media {
  height: 190px;
}

.vertical-card-compact h3 {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
}

.vertical-card-compact .card-action-btn {
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Process Stepper (How it Works)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.process-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 4rem 3.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.stepper {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1.75rem;
  margin-top: 1.75rem;
}

.step {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.step:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.step-number {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-text);
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.step h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.step p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Important Info Memo Callout
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.info-callout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2.5rem 3rem;
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.info-callout-content {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 1.75rem;
}

.info-icon-badge {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

.info-callout h2 {
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0.45rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.info-callout p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 46rem;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Vertical Overview Page
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.vertical-overview-page {
  padding-top: 1rem;
}

.vertical-overview-banner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 3rem;
  align-items: center;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 3.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.vertical-banner-content h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0.85rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.vertical-banner-content p {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0 0 1.75rem;
  max-width: 40rem;
}

.vertical-banner-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.vertical-banner-image-box {
  width: 100%;
  height: 250px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--color-surface-subtle);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.vertical-banner-image-box img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.deliverables-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2rem 2.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.deliverables-section ul {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.85rem 2rem;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 1rem 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.deliverables-section li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.deliverables-section li::before {
  content: '✓';
  color: #10b981;
  font-weight: 800;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Filter Bar & Task Cards
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.task-list-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.task-list-heading h2 {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
}

.task-result-count {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.task-filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.75rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.task-filter-bar label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.task-filter-bar select {
  min-height: 44px;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.45rem 2rem 0.45rem 0.95rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.task-filter-bar select:hover,
.task-filter-bar select:focus {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.task-card {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2rem 2.25rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.task-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.task-card-main {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.task-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.task-card-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.task-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-card p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0;
}

.task-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.task-card-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
}

.task-card-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.tag-chip {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.task-card-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.task-card:hover .task-card-action {
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Difficulty Badge & Meta Chips
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.difficulty-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  min-height: 30px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-difficulty-color, var(--color-border));
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--difficulty-color) 12%, #ffffff);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.25rem 0.8rem;
  color: var(--difficulty-color);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.difficulty-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: currentColor;
}

.time-estimate {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Detail Page
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.task-detail-page {
  max-width: 56rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
}

.breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
}

.breadcrumb a {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.breadcrumb-separator {
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.breadcrumb-current {
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.task-detail-header {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 3rem;
  margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.task-detail-header h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0.35rem 0 1.25rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-detail-header > p {
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 2rem;
  max-width: 46rem;
}

.task-detail-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding-top: 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

.task-detail-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2.25rem;
}

/* Task Section */
.task-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.task-section-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.task-section-content {
  color: #1e293b;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.task-section-content h2,
.task-section-content h3,
.task-section-content h1 {
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 1.75rem 0 0.85rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-section-content h1 { font-size: 1.7rem; }
.task-section-content h2 { font-size: 1.45rem; }
.task-section-content h3 { font-size: 1.22rem; }

.task-section-content p {
  color: #334155;
  margin: 0.95rem 0;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}

.task-section-content ul,
.task-section-content ol {
  color: #334155;
  padding-left: 1.6rem;
  margin: 0.95rem 0;
}

.task-section-content li {
  padding: 0.3rem 0;
}

.task-section-content strong {
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-section-content a {
  color: #0284c7;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}

.task-section-content code {
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.9em;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.task-section-content pre {
  margin: 1.75rem 0;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
  border: 1px solid #1e293b;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background-color: #0f172a;
  color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.task-section-content pre code {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.criteria-list {
  list-style: none !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.criteria-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}

.criteria-checkbox {
  color: #10b981;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Expandable Section & Resources
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.expandable-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.expandable-section summary {
  min-height: 56px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 1.4rem 2rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  user-select: none;
  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.expandable-section summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.expandable-section summary:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
}

.expandable-content {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding: 2rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
}

.resource-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.resource-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.6rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.resource-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.resource-type {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.resource-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.resource-card p {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  flex: 1;
}

.resource-card a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.resource-card a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Submission Panel
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.submission-panel {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 2.25rem;
  background-color: #0a0a0a;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2.5rem 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.submission-panel-done {
  align-items: center;
}

.submission-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  color: #ffffff;
  background-color: #262626;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.submission-icon-success {
  color: #34d399;
}

.submission-copy {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.submission-copy h2 {
  font-size: 1.55rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.submission-copy p {
  color: #d4d4d8;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
}

.submission-panel .primary-button {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #0a0a0a;
  border-color: #ffffff;
}

.submission-panel .primary-button:hover {
  background-color: #f4f4f5;
}

.submission-panel .primary-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.7;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
}

.submission-guidelines-card {
  padding: 2.5rem;
}

.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-header {
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-content ul,
.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-content ol {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.2rem;
  color: #334155;
  line-height: 1.75;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-content li + li {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.submission-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.95rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
}

.submission-form-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.95rem;
}

.submission-form-row .submission-field {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.submission-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.submission-field span {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: #a1a1aa;
}

.submission-field input,
.submission-field textarea {
  min-height: 44px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.submission-field textarea {
  min-height: auto;
  resize: vertical;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
}

.submission-field input::placeholder,
.submission-field textarea::placeholder {
  color: #6b6b76;
}

.submission-field input:focus-visible,
.submission-field textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #ffffff;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.submission-field input:disabled,
.submission-field textarea:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.submission-error {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 0;
  color: #fca5a5;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.submission-error svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
}

.submission-error a {
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}

.submission-spinner {
  animation: submission-spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes submission-spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Navigation (Prev/Next)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.task-nav {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding: 3rem 0 1rem;
  margin-top: 3rem;
}

.task-nav > div {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.task-nav > div:last-child {
  text-align: right;
}

.task-nav a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  min-height: 54px;
  max-width: 100%;
  color: var(--color-text);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  padding: 0.85rem 1.65rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.task-nav a:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.task-nav a span {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.task-nav > div:last-child a span {
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.task-nav small {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Detail Signature Themes
   Gotham (Electronics · Batman & Joker) · Stark HUD (Software · Iron Man)
   Cybernetic Core (Mechanical · DC / Cyborg)

   Each theme is a self-contained palette of --tt-* variables applied to
   .task-detail-page. The structural rules below (spacing, radii, shadows,
   type ramp) are shared with the rest of the site — only color, glow and a
   small decorative emblem change per vertical.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.theme-tagline-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.32rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--tt-bg-1) 0%, var(--tt-bg-2) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 40px 90px -30px var(--tt-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham::before,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark::before,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background-image: var(--tt-pattern);
}

/* Breadcrumb */
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb {
  color: var(--tt-text-muted);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb a,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb a,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb a {
  color: var(--tt-text-muted);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb a:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb a:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--tt-text);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb-separator,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb-separator,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb-separator {
  color: var(--tt-border-strong);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb-current,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb-current,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb-current {
  color: var(--tt-text);
}

/* Pills & chips */
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .track-pill,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .track-pill,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .track-pill {
  background: var(--tt-accent);
  color: var(--tt-bg-1);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .section-tag-badge,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .section-tag-badge,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .section-tag-badge {
  background: var(--tt-surface-strong);
  border-color: var(--tt-border);
  color: var(--tt-text);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .theme-tagline-pill,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .theme-tagline-pill,

/* Header card + emblem */

/* Section cards, expandables, resources */
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .expandable-section,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .expandable-section,

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .resource-card,

.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .resource-card,

}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-header,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-header,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-header {
  border-bottom-color: var(--tt-border);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content p,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content p,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content p,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content ul,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content ul,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content ul,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content ol,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content ol,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content ol {

}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content h2,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content h2,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content h2,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content h1,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content h1,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content h1,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content h3,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content h3,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content h3,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content strong,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content strong,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content strong,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .criteria-list li,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .criteria-list li,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .criteria-list li {

}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content a,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content a,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content a,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .criteria-checkbox,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .criteria-checkbox,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .criteria-checkbox,
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .resource-card a,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .resource-card a,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .resource-card a {

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content code,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content code,

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-section-content pre,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-section-content pre,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-section-content pre {
  border-color: var(--tt-border);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .expandable-section summary,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .expandable-section summary,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .expandable-section summary {

}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .expandable-section summary:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .expandable-section summary:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .expandable-section summary:hover {

}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .expandable-content,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .expandable-content,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .expandable-content {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
  border-top-color: var(--tt-border);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .resource-card:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .resource-card:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .resource-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--tt-accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--tt-accent) inset, 0 20px 40px -16px var(--tt-shadow);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .resource-type,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .resource-type,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .resource-type {
  color: var(--tt-text-muted);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .resource-card h3,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .resource-card h3,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .resource-card h3 {
  color: var(--tt-text);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .resource-card p,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .resource-card p,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .resource-card p {
