/* ==========================================================================
   ASME RECRUITMENT PORTAL — UNITREE / ROBOX INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT THEME
   Fancy Animated Navbar, Smooth Parallax Stage, Clean Typography & Spacing
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   App Shell & Page Container
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-shell {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--color-background);
  color: var(--color-text);
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.app-shell::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.16;
  background-image: url('./assets/image.png');
  background-size: 100% auto;
  background-position: center top;
  background-repeat: repeat-y;
  filter: brightness(1.45) saturate(0.8) contrast(0.85);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .app-shell::before {
  opacity: 0.72;
  filter: brightness(0.72) saturate(1.1) contrast(1.05);
}

.page-content {
  flex: 1;
  width: min(100% - 3rem, 78rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 0 6rem;
  position: relative;
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .page-content > :not(.task-detail-page) {
  --color-surface: #111111;
  --color-surface-hover: #1c1c1c;
  --color-surface-subtle: #181818;
  --color-surface-card: #111111;
  --color-text: #ffffff;
  --color-text-secondary: #e4e4e7;
  --color-text-muted: #a1a1aa;
  --color-text-subtle: #71717a;
  --color-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --color-border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --color-border-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  --color-border-strong: #ffffff;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Typography Badges & Micro Labels (Clean, No '//' Slashes)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.section-tag-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
  width: fit-content;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
}

.hero-eyebrow-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.95rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Buttons & Micro-interactions
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.primary-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.75rem;
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-text);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

.primary-button:hover {
  background-color: #262626;
  border-color: #262626;
  color: #ffffff;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.primary-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.secondary-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.65rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.secondary-button:hover {
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
  color: #000000;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}

.text-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.text-link:hover {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.text-link svg {
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.text-link:hover svg {
  transform: translate(2px, -2px);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Fancy Animated Floating Capsule Navigation
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.site-header-wrapper {
  position: sticky;
  top: 1.25rem;
  z-index: 1000;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.site-header-wrapper.is-scrolled {
  top: 0.75rem;
}

.site-header-capsule {
  pointer-events: auto;
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  height: 56px;
  background-color: rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.94);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.site-header-wrapper.is-scrolled .site-header-capsule {
  height: 50px;
  max-width: 48rem;
  background-color: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 45px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
}

.capsule-glow-border {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), rgba(255,255,255,0.25), rgba(255,255,255,0.08));
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.6;
  mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
}

.nav-group-left,
.nav-group-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  flex: 1;
}

.nav-group-right {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.capsule-brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0 1.25rem;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), opacity var(--transition-fast);
}

.capsule-brand-mark {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: top center;
}

.capsule-brand:hover {
  transform: scale(1.03);
  opacity: 0.95;
}

.brand-badge-year {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #a1a1aa;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
}

.capsule-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 2.15rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #a1a1aa;
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.capsule-link:hover {
  color: #ffffff;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.capsule-link.is-active {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.capsule-cta-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 2.15rem;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #000000;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.capsule-cta-pill:hover {
  background-color: #e4e4e7;
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

.theme-toggle-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  min-height: 34px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  color: #ffffff;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.theme-toggle-button:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.mobile-menu-drawer .theme-toggle-button {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  min-height: 44px;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: #a1a1aa;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.mobile-menu-drawer .theme-toggle-button:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: #ffffff;
  transform: none;
}

.menu-button {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Mobile Nav Drawer */
@media (max-width: 52rem) {
  .menu-button {
    display: inline-flex;
  }

  .nav-group-left,
  .nav-group-right {
    display: none;
  }

  .site-header-capsule {
    padding: 0 1.25rem;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .mobile-menu-drawer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 64px;
    left: 1.5rem;
    right: 1.5rem;
    background-color: #111111;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.85rem;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    pointer-events: auto;
    animation: drawer-fade-in 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  }

  @keyframes drawer-fade-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  .mobile-menu-drawer .capsule-link {
    min-height: 44px;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  }

  .mobile-menu-drawer .capsule-link:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Hero Hardware Stage with Scroll Parallax Motion
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.hero-hardware-section {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2rem;
}

.hero-top-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.hero-title-main {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.5vw, 6.4rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 0.95;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  color: var(--color-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0;
}

.hero-subtitle-box {
  max-width: 25rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.hero-subtitle-box p {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.hero-actions-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* Main Studio Stage */
.hardware-stage {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--color-stage-bg);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 35px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease-out;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
}

.stage-light-ambient {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 70%;
  height: 40%;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.stage-image {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  max-height: 640px;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease-out;
}

/* Floating Spec Card (Continuous Levitation Motion) */
.floating-spec-card {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 2.5rem;
  right: 2.5rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.75rem 2rem;
  max-width: 330px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  z-index: 10;
  animation: floatCard 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes floatCard {
  0% {
    transform: translateY(0px);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }
}

.spec-icon-badge {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.floating-spec-card h3 {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--color-text);
  margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
}

.floating-spec-card p {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 52rem) {
  .hero-top-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .floating-spec-card {
    position: static;
    margin: 1.25rem;
    max-width: none;
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Recruitment Stats Strip
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.stats-section {
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
}

.section-heading {
  margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
}

.section-heading h2 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.8vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.section-heading-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.stats-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.stat-block {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2rem 1.75rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.stat-block:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.stat-header-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.stat-index-badge {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.stat-label-text {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--color-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.stat-block strong {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.95rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-text);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.stat-sub {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Vertical Cards (Physical Hardware Cards)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.vertical-preview-section {
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
}

.vertical-preview-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1.75rem;
}

.vertical-selection-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 2rem;
}

.vertical-card {
  --vertical-accent: var(--color-steel);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.vertical-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.vertical-card-media {
  width: 100%;
  height: 220px;
  background-color: var(--color-surface-subtle);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.vertical-card-media img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.vertical-card:hover .vertical-card-media img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.vertical-card-body {
  padding: 1.85rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex: 1;
}

.card-topline {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.95rem;
}

.track-pill {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

.vertical-card h2,
.vertical-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.vertical-card p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.94rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
}

.card-deliverables {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding-top: 1.25rem;
}

.card-deliverables .section-tag-badge {
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
}

.card-deliverables ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.card-deliverables li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #334155;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.card-deliverables li::before {
  content: '✓';
  color: #10b981;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.vertical-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 1.35rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

.background-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.card-action-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem;
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.vertical-card:hover .card-action-btn {
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

/* Compact mode for Landing Page */
.vertical-card-compact .vertical-card-media {
  height: 190px;
}

.vertical-card-compact h3 {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
}

.vertical-card-compact .card-action-btn {
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  width: 100%;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Process Stepper (How it Works)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.process-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 4rem 3.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.stepper {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1.75rem;
  margin-top: 1.75rem;
}

.step {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.step:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.step-number {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-text);
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.step h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.step p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Important Info Memo Callout
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.info-callout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2.5rem 3rem;
  margin-bottom: 5.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.info-callout-content {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 1.75rem;
}

.info-icon-badge {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

.info-callout h2 {
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0.45rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.info-callout p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 46rem;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Vertical Overview Page
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.vertical-overview-page {
  padding-top: 1rem;
}

.vertical-overview-banner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 3rem;
  align-items: center;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 3.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.vertical-banner-content h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0.85rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.vertical-banner-content p {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0 0 1.75rem;
  max-width: 40rem;
}

.vertical-banner-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.vertical-banner-image-box {
  width: 100%;
  height: 250px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--color-surface-subtle);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.vertical-banner-image-box img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.deliverables-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2rem 2.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.deliverables-section ul {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.85rem 2rem;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 1rem 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.deliverables-section li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.deliverables-section li::before {
  content: '✓';
  color: #10b981;
  font-weight: 800;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Filter Bar & Task Cards
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.task-list-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.task-list-heading h2 {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0.35rem 0 0;
}

.task-result-count {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.task-filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.75rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.task-filter-bar label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.task-filter-bar select {
  min-height: 44px;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.45rem 2rem 0.45rem 0.95rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.task-filter-bar select:hover,
.task-filter-bar select:focus {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.task-card {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2rem 2.25rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.task-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.task-card-main {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.task-card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.task-card-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.task-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-card p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0;
}

.task-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.task-card-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
}

.task-card-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.tag-chip {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.task-card-action {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.task-card:hover .task-card-action {
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Difficulty Badge & Meta Chips
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.difficulty-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  min-height: 30px;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-difficulty-color, var(--color-border));
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--difficulty-color) 12%, #ffffff);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  padding: 0.25rem 0.8rem;
  color: var(--difficulty-color);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.difficulty-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: currentColor;
}

.time-estimate {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Detail Page
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.task-detail-page {
  max-width: 56rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
}

.breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
}

.breadcrumb a {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
}

.breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.breadcrumb-separator {
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.breadcrumb-current {
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.task-detail-header {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 3rem;
  margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.task-detail-header h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0.35rem 0 1.25rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-detail-header > p {
  font-size: 1.18rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 2rem;
  max-width: 46rem;
}

.task-detail-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  padding-top: 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

.task-detail-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2.25rem;
}

/* Task Section */
.task-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.task-section-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.task-section-content {
  color: #1e293b;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.task-section-content h2,
.task-section-content h3,
.task-section-content h1 {
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 1.75rem 0 0.85rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-section-content h1 { font-size: 1.7rem; }
.task-section-content h2 { font-size: 1.45rem; }
.task-section-content h3 { font-size: 1.22rem; }

.task-section-content p {
  color: #334155;
  margin: 0.95rem 0;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}

.task-section-content ul,
.task-section-content ol {
  color: #334155;
  padding-left: 1.6rem;
  margin: 0.95rem 0;
}

.task-section-content li {
  padding: 0.3rem 0;
}

.task-section-content strong {
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.task-section-content a {
  color: #0284c7;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}

.task-section-content code {
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.9em;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.task-section-content pre {
  margin: 1.75rem 0;
  padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
  border: 1px solid #1e293b;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background-color: #0f172a;
  color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.task-section-content pre code {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.criteria-list {
  list-style: none !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.criteria-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}

.criteria-checkbox {
  color: #10b981;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Expandable Section & Resources
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.expandable-section {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.expandable-section summary {
  min-height: 56px;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 1.4rem 2rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  user-select: none;
  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.expandable-section summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.expandable-section summary:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
}

.expandable-content {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding: 2rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
}

.resource-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.resource-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.6rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-base);
}

.resource-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.resource-type {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.resource-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.resource-card p {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  flex: 1;
}

.resource-card a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.resource-card a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Submission Panel
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.submission-panel {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 2.25rem;
  background-color: #0a0a0a;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 2.5rem 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.submission-panel-done {
  align-items: center;
}

.submission-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  color: #ffffff;
  background-color: #262626;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.submission-icon-success {
  color: #34d399;
}

.submission-copy {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.submission-copy h2 {
  font-size: 1.55rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0.5rem;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.submission-copy p {
  color: #d4d4d8;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
}

.submission-panel .primary-button {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #0a0a0a;
  border-color: #ffffff;
}

.submission-panel .primary-button:hover {
  background-color: #f4f4f5;
}

.submission-panel .primary-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.7;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
}

.submission-guidelines-card {
  padding: 2.5rem;
}

.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-header {
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-content ul,
.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-content ol {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 1.2rem;
  color: #334155;
  line-height: 1.75;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.submission-guidelines-card .task-section-content li + li {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.submission-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.95rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
}

.submission-form-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.95rem;
}

.submission-form-row .submission-field {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.submission-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.submission-field span {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: #a1a1aa;
}

.submission-field input,
.submission-field textarea {
  min-height: 44px;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.submission-field textarea {
  min-height: auto;
  resize: vertical;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
}

.submission-field input::placeholder,
.submission-field textarea::placeholder {
  color: #6b6b76;
}

.submission-field input:focus-visible,
.submission-field textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #ffffff;
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.submission-field input:disabled,
.submission-field textarea:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.submission-error {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 0;
  color: #fca5a5;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.submission-error svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
}

.submission-error a {
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}

.submission-spinner {
  animation: submission-spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes submission-spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Navigation (Prev/Next)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.task-nav {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding: 3rem 0 1rem;
  margin-top: 3rem;
}

.task-nav > div {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.task-nav > div:last-child {
  text-align: right;
}

.task-nav a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  min-height: 54px;
  max-width: 100%;
  color: var(--color-text);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  padding: 0.85rem 1.65rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.task-nav a:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.task-nav a span {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.task-nav > div:last-child a span {
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.task-nav small {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Task Detail Signature Themes
   Gotham (Electronics · Batman & Joker) · Stark HUD (Software · Iron Man)
   Cybernetic Core (Mechanical · DC / Cyborg)

   Each theme is a self-contained palette of --tt-* variables applied to
   .task-detail-page. The structural rules below (spacing, radii, shadows,
   type ramp) are shared with the rest of the site — only color, glow and a
   small decorative emblem change per vertical.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.theme-tagline-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.32rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--tt-bg-1) 0%, var(--tt-bg-2) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 40px 90px -30px var(--tt-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham::before,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark::before,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background-image: var(--tt-pattern);
}

/* Breadcrumb */
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb {
  color: var(--tt-text-muted);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb a,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb a,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb a {
  color: var(--tt-text-muted);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb a:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb a:hover,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--tt-text);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb-separator,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb-separator,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb-separator {
  color: var(--tt-border-strong);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .breadcrumb-current,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .breadcrumb-current,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .breadcrumb-current {
  color: var(--tt-text);
}

/* Pills & chips */
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .track-pill,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .track-pill,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .track-pill {
  background: var(--tt-accent);
  color: var(--tt-bg-1);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .section-tag-badge,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .section-tag-badge,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .section-tag-badge {
  background: var(--tt-surface-strong);
  border-color: var(--tt-border);
  color: var(--tt-text);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .theme-tagline-pill,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .theme-tagline-pill,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .theme-tagline-pill {
  background: var(--tt-surface-strong);
  border-color: var(--tt-border-strong);
  color: var(--tt-accent);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .tag-chip,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .tag-chip,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .tag-chip {
  background: var(--tt-surface);
  border-color: var(--tt-border);
  color: var(--tt-text-secondary);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .time-estimate,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .time-estimate,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .time-estimate {
  color: var(--tt-text-muted);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .difficulty-badge,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .difficulty-badge,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .difficulty-badge {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--difficulty-color) 20%, transparent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--difficulty-color) 45%, transparent);
}

/* Header card + emblem */
.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-detail-header,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-detail-header,
.task-detail-page.theme-spiderman .task-detail-header {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--tt-surface);
  border-color: var(--tt-border);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-gotham .task-detail-header h1,
.task-detail-page.theme-stark .task-detail-header h1,

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Gotham — Electronics (Batman & Joker)
   Moody near-black stage, bat-signal yellow + joker purple duotone.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.theme-gotham {
  --tt-bg-1: #0a0a10;
  --tt-bg-2: #1a1024;
  --tt-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  --tt-surface-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075);
  --tt-border: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.22);
  --tt-border-strong: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.45);
  --tt-text: #f7f5fb;
  --tt-text-secondary: #d3cee0;
  --tt-text-muted: #948db0;
  --tt-accent: #eab308;
  --tt-code-bg: #050508;
  --tt-shadow: rgba(20, 8, 35, 0.7);
  --tt-pattern:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 88% -8%, rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.18), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at -8% 108%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.16), transparent 62%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015) 0 2px, transparent 2px 26px);
}

.theme-gotham .theme-tagline-pill {
  animation: gotham-flicker 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  @keyframes gotham-flicker {
    0%, 92%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    93% { opacity: 0.55; }
    95% { opacity: 1; }
    96% { opacity: 0.7; }
    97% { opacity: 1; }
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Stark HUD — Software (Iron Man)
   Dark repulsor-tech stage, red/gold plating with an arc-reactor glow.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.theme-stark {
  --tt-bg-1: #0b0d11;
  --tt-bg-2: #170b0a;
  --tt-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  --tt-surface-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075);
  --tt-border: rgba(245, 180, 0, 0.24);
  --tt-border-strong: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
  --tt-text: #f8f6ef;
  --tt-text-secondary: #d9d1bf;
  --tt-text-muted: #a2957d;
  --tt-accent: #f5b400;
  --tt-code-bg: #0a0604;
  --tt-shadow: rgba(20, 4, 4, 0.7);
  --tt-pattern:
    radial-gradient(circle at 88% 6%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18), transparent 42%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 8% 102%, rgba(226, 35, 26, 0.14), transparent 62%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 0 1px, transparent 1px 30px),
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02) 0 1px, transparent 1px 30px);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Web-Slinger Ops — Mechanical (Spider-Man)
   Night-city stage in Spidey red/blue, with a faint web radiating from
   the top-left corner instead of the other themes' grid/stripe textures.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.theme-spiderman {
  --tt-bg-1: #0a0a12;
  --tt-bg-2: #1a0a10;
  --tt-surface: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
  --tt-surface-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.075);
  --tt-border: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.26);
  --tt-border-strong: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5);
  --tt-text: #f6f3f0;
  --tt-text-secondary: #dcd3ce;
  --tt-text-muted: #a89a95;
  --tt-accent: #e6303c;
  --tt-code-bg: #08050a;
  --tt-shadow: rgba(15, 5, 10, 0.7);
  --tt-pattern:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 88% -8%, rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.16), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at -8% 108%, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.18), transparent 62%),
    repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 12% -12%, transparent 0 34px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035) 35px, transparent 36px),
    repeating-conic-gradient(from 200deg at 12% -12%, transparent 0deg 14deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035) 14.6deg 15deg);
}

.theme-spiderman .theme-tagline-pill::before {
  content: '';
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #e6303c;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px 2px rgba(230, 48, 60, 0.7);
  margin-right: 0.15rem;
}

/* Electrical Task 2 — premium Spider-Man treatment */
.theme-electrical-task2 {
  --tt-bg-1: #0a0a0c;
  --tt-bg-2: #121215;
  --tt-surface: rgba(18, 18, 21, 0.96);
  --tt-surface-strong: rgba(27, 42, 74, 0.96);
  --tt-border: rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.34);
  --tt-border-strong: rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.3);
  --tt-text: #f5f5f5;
  --tt-text-secondary: #d6d9e3;
  --tt-text-muted: #9ba6c0;
  --tt-accent: #e62429;
  --tt-code-bg: #070b1c;
  --tt-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.86);
  --tt-pattern:
    radial-gradient(circle at 91% 4%, rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.13), transparent 32%),
    repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 8% -8%, transparent 0 38px, rgba(110, 124, 151, 0.07) 39px 40px, transparent 41px),
    repeating-conic-gradient(from 195deg at 8% -8%, transparent 0deg 14deg, rgba(110, 124, 151, 0.06) 14.5deg 15deg);
}

.task-detail-page.theme-electrical-task2 {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  background: #0a0a0c;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.theme-electrical-task2 > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header,
.theme-electrical-task2 .task-section,
.theme-electrical-task2 .resource-card,
.theme-electrical-task2 .submission-panel,
.theme-electrical-task2 .task-nav a {
  background-color: rgba(18, 18, 21, 0.96);
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header {
  min-height: 31rem;
  isolation: isolate;
  background: #121215;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95), 0 0 38px -20px rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.64), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.08);
}

.task2-hero-kicker {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1.45rem;
  left: 3rem;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--tt-accent);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.task2-top-panel,
.task2-bottom-panel {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  background: #0a0a0c;
}

.task2-top-panel {
  max-height: min(58vh, 42rem);
  object-position: center top;
  filter: saturate(1.03) contrast(1.05) drop-shadow(0 18px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65));
}

.task2-flow-stage {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  margin: 0 -0.25rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem 0;
  background-color: #0a0a0c;
  background-repeat: repeat-y;
  background-position: center top;
  background-size: min(11rem, 28vw) auto;
  box-shadow: inset 0 18px 32px -28px rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.5), inset 0 -18px 32px -28px rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.5);
}

.task2-flow-stage::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0a0a0c 0%, rgba(10, 10, 12, 0.32) 22%, rgba(10, 10, 12, 0.32) 78%, #0a0a0c 100%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.task2-flow-stage .task-detail-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.task2-bottom-panel {
  max-height: min(58vh, 42rem);
  object-position: center bottom;
  filter: saturate(1.03) contrast(1.05) drop-shadow(0 -18px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65));
  will-change: transform;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header::before {
  display: none;
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-section {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 22px 42px -28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95), 0 0 20px -18px rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.8);
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task2-story-status {
  min-height: 1.5rem;
  margin: 0 0 1.35rem;
  color: var(--tt-accent);
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .typed-cursor {
  color: var(--tt-accent);
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.8);
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-section-header::after {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  height: 1px;
  margin-top: 0.85rem;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--tt-accent), rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.15), transparent 78%);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-section.is-visible .task-section-header::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

.theme-electrical-task2 .task-section.is-visible .task-section-header .section-tag-badge {
  animation: task2-heading-activate 500ms ease-out both;
}

@keyframes task2-heading-activate {
  from { opacity: 0.45; transform: translateX(-5px); text-shadow: none; }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(230, 36, 41, 0.45); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .theme-spiderman .theme-tagline-pill::before {
    animation: spidey-sense-pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes spidey-sense-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; }
    50% { opacity: 1; }
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Header Character Art
   A large, faded character portrait bleeds in from the right edge of each
   themed header — Joker for Gotham, Iron Man for Stark, Spider-Man for
   Web-Slinger Ops — masked to fade into the card so the title stays
   readable. Desktop only; collapses to the plain themed surface on small
   screens.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (min-width: 60rem) {
  .theme-gotham .task-detail-header::before,
  .theme-stark .task-detail-header::before,
  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-header::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: -1;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-position: right top;
    filter: brightness(0.6) saturate(0.85) contrast(1.08);
    pointer-events: none;
    /* The fade is sized to the image's own box (mask-size below) so it
       always completes exactly at the image's edge — never past it into
       empty space, which is what causes a visible hard seam. */
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to left, black 0%, black 25%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(to left, black 0%, black 25%, transparent 100%);
    -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    mask-repeat: no-repeat;
    -webkit-mask-position: right top;
    mask-position: right top;
  }

  .theme-gotham .task-detail-header::before {
    background-image: url('./assets/joker.jpg');
    background-size: 320px auto;
    -webkit-mask-size: 320px 100%;
    mask-size: 320px 100%;
  }

  .theme-stark .task-detail-header::before {
    background-image: url('./assets/iron-man.jpg');
    background-size: 320px auto;
    -webkit-mask-size: 320px 100%;
    mask-size: 320px 100%;
    filter: brightness(0.42) saturate(0.7) contrast(1.15);
  }

  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-header::before {
    background-position: right center;
    -webkit-mask-position: right center;
    mask-position: right center;
    background-image: url('./assets/spiderman.png');
    background-size: 400px auto;
    -webkit-mask-size: 400px 100%;
    mask-size: 400px 100%;
    filter: brightness(0.62) saturate(0.9) contrast(1.1);
  }

  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header::before {
    display: none;
  }

  /* A soft color wash between the header surface and the photo so the two
     read as one designed panel rather than a photo pasted on top. */
  .theme-gotham .task-detail-header::after,
  .theme-stark .task-detail-header::after,
  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-header::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: -1;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .theme-gotham .task-detail-header::after {
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(10, 8, 14, 0.35) 0%, rgba(88, 40, 140, 0.16) 38%, transparent 62%);
  }

  .theme-stark .task-detail-header::after {
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(10, 6, 4, 0.55) 0%, rgba(180, 60, 20, 0.2) 42%, transparent 72%);
  }

  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-header::after {
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(15, 5, 10, 0.4) 0%, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16) 38%, transparent 62%);
  }

  /* Keep header copy clear of the portrait's right-hand side */
  .theme-gotham .task-detail-header h1,
  .theme-gotham .task-detail-header > p,
  .theme-gotham .task-detail-badges,
  .theme-gotham .task-detail-meta,
  .theme-stark .task-detail-header h1,
  .theme-stark .task-detail-header > p,
  .theme-stark .task-detail-badges,
  .theme-stark .task-detail-meta {
    max-width: 28rem;
  }

  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-header h1,
  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-header > p,
  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-badges,
  .theme-spiderman .task-detail-meta {
    max-width: 23rem;
  }

  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header h1,
  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header > p,
  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-badges,
  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-meta {
    max-width: 23rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 48rem) {
  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header {
    min-height: 31rem;
  }

  .task2-hero-image {
    right: -2rem;
    width: 58%;
    height: 54%;
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 58%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000 58%, transparent 100%);
  }

  .task2-hero-kicker {
    left: 1.5rem;
    font-size: 0.58rem;
  }

  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header h1,
  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-header > p,
  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-badges,
  .theme-electrical-task2 .task-detail-meta {
    max-width: 100%;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   3D Header Emblems
   Original, CSS-only 3D objects (not character likenesses) that sit in the
   top-right corner of each themed task header: a spinning medallion, a
   layered arc-reactor, and a rotating hexagonal core prism.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.emblem-3d {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1.5rem;
  right: 1.75rem;
  width: 84px;
  height: 84px;
  perspective: 600px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Gotham — spinning bat medallion */
.emblem-gotham .emblem-3d-spin {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .emblem-gotham .emblem-3d-spin {
    animation: emblem-spin-y 7s linear infinite;
  }
}

@keyframes emblem-spin-y {
  from { transform: rotateY(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotateY(360deg); }
}

.emblem-gotham .emblem-face {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 2.3rem;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(circle, #1a1720 0%, #0d0b12 70%);
  border: 2px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.55);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 6px rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.08),
    0 0 22px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5),
    inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 -6px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.emblem-gotham .emblem-face-back {
  transform: rotateY(180deg);
}

/* Stark — layered, tilted arc reactor */
.emblem-stark .reactor-3d {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  transform: rotateX(52deg) rotateZ(0deg);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .emblem-stark .reactor-3d {
    animation: reactor-spin 6s linear infinite;
  }
}

@keyframes reactor-spin {
  from { transform: rotateX(52deg) rotateZ(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotateX(52deg) rotateZ(360deg); }
}

.emblem-stark .reactor-ring {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 3px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
}

.emblem-stark .reactor-ring-1 {
  inset: 0;
  transform: translateZ(16px);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8);
}

.emblem-stark .reactor-ring-2 {
  inset: 9px;
  transform: translateZ(9px);
  border-color: rgba(245, 180, 0, 0.6);
}

.emblem-stark .reactor-ring-3 {
  inset: 18px;
  transform: translateZ(2px);
  border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
}

.emblem-stark .reactor-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 27px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, #ffffff 0%, #8fe8ff 35%, #17c1e8 65%, transparent 75%);
  transform: translateZ(22px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 28px 9px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.65);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .emblem-stark .reactor-core {
    animation: reactor-core-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
}

@keyframes reactor-core-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.75; }
  50% { opacity: 1; }
}

/* Spider-Man — spinning web-shooter medallion */
.emblem-spiderman .emblem-3d-spin {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .emblem-spiderman .emblem-3d-spin {
    animation: emblem-spin-y 7s linear infinite;
  }
}

.emblem-spiderman .emblem-face {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 2.3rem;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(circle, #2a0a0e 0%, #12070a 70%);
  border: 2px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.6);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 6px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08),
    0 0 22px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5),
    inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 -6px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.emblem-spiderman .emblem-face-back {
  transform: rotateY(180deg);
}

@media (max-width: 48rem) {
  .emblem-3d {
    width: 62px;
    height: 62px;
    top: 1.1rem;
    right: 1.1rem;
  }

  .emblem-gotham .emblem-face,
  .emblem-spiderman .emblem-face {
    font-size: 1.7rem;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Editorial How It Works & FAQ Pages
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.editorial-page {
  padding-top: 1.5rem;
}

.editorial-header {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 4rem 3.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.editorial-header h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.editorial-header p {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  max-width: 48rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.how-it-works-cta {
  margin-top: 3.5rem;
}

.faq-categories {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.faq-tab {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 0.65rem 1.35rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.faq-tab:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.faq-tab.is-active {
  background-color: var(--color-text);
  border-color: var(--color-text);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

.faq-accordion-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.15rem;
}

.faq-item {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
}

.faq-item:hover {
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}

.faq-summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text);
  list-style: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.faq-summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

.faq-summary:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
}

.faq-content {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding: 1.5rem 2rem 2rem;
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  color: #334155;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.faq-content p {
  margin: 0 0 0.85rem;
}

.faq-content p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Site Footer
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.site-footer {
  width: 100%;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  padding: 4rem 0 3rem;
  margin-top: auto;
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .site-footer {
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  background-color: #111111;
  color: #a1a1aa;
}

.site-footer-inner {
  width: min(100% - 3rem, 78rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 3.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-brand {
  max-width: 25rem;
}

.footer-logo-mark {
  display: block;
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.footer-brand p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.footer-columns {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.footer-col a {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: color var(--transition-fast);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.footer-col a:hover {
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.footer-bottom {
  width: min(100% - 3rem, 78rem);
  margin: 3.5rem auto 0;
  padding-top: 1.75rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Responsive Media Queries
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width: 64rem) {
  .vertical-preview-grid,
  .vertical-selection-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .stats-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .stepper {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .vertical-overview-banner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 48rem) {
  .page-content {
    width: min(100% - 1.5rem, 78rem);
    padding: 1.25rem 0 4rem;
  }

  .vertical-preview-grid,
  .vertical-selection-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .stats-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .stepper {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .info-callout {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 2rem 1.75rem;
  }

  .task-card {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 1.75rem;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }

  .task-card-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .task-card-footer {
    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.85rem;
  }

  .task-card-action {
    align-self: flex-end;
  }

  .resource-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .submission-panel {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 2rem;
  }

  .submission-panel .primary-button {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .submission-form-row {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .task-nav {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1.25rem;
  }

  .task-nav > div,
  .task-nav > div:last-child {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
  }

  .task-nav a {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .editorial-header {
    padding: 2.5rem 1.75rem;
  }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Dark Mode — remaining spot-fixes

   Most of the site already reads its colors from the CSS custom properties
   defined in index.css, which flip automatically under [data-theme="dark"].
   The handful of rules below are the ones that used a literal hex value
   with no exact variable equivalent (hover-darken states, a couple of
   muted grays), so they get an explicit dark-mode value here instead.
   The floating navbar, footer status line, and the Batman/Iron Man/Cyborg
   task themes are intentionally left untouched — they're fixed-dark by
   design regardless of the site-wide toggle.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
:root[data-theme='dark'] .primary-button:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  border-color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  color: var(--color-background);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .secondary-button:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
  border-color: var(--color-border-hover);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .difficulty-badge {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--difficulty-color) 18%, var(--color-surface));
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .hardware-stage,
:root[data-theme='dark'] .floating-spec-card {
  border-color: var(--color-border-subtle);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .card-deliverables li,
:root[data-theme='dark'] .task-section-content p,
:root[data-theme='dark'] .task-section-content ul,
:root[data-theme='dark'] .task-section-content ol,
:root[data-theme='dark'] .faq-content {
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .task-filter-bar select,
:root[data-theme='dark'] .faq-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-border-hover);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .breadcrumb-separator {
  color: var(--color-border-hover);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .footer-bottom {
  color: var(--color-text-subtle);
}

.task-deadline {
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.vertical-contact-section {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  margin: 1.5rem 0 2.5rem;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--vertical-accent);
  border-block: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

@media (max-width: 48rem) {
  .task-deadline {
    flex-basis: 100%;
  }
}

.task-section-content blockquote {
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--vertical-accent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vertical-accent) 5%, var(--color-surface));
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.task-section-content table {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 1.25rem 0;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.task-section-content th,
.task-section-content td {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.task-section-content th {
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.task-section-content td {
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
}

.task-section-content img {
  display: block;
  width: min(100%, 38rem);
  height: auto;
  max-height: 28rem;
  margin: 1.25rem auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

@media (max-width: 48rem) {
  .task-section-content img {
    width: 100%;
    max-height: 22rem;
    margin: 1rem auto;
  }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   ASME RECRUITMENT PORTAL — UNITREE / ROBOX INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT THEME
   Fancy Animated Navbar, Smooth Parallax Stage, Clean Typography & Spacing
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   App Shell & Page Container
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.app-shell {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background-color: var(--color-background);
  color: var(--color-text);
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.app-shell::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.16;
  background-image: url('./assets/image.png');
  background-size: 100% auto;
  background-position: center top;
  background-repeat: repeat-y;
  filter: brightness(1.45) saturate(0.8) contrast(0.85);
}

:root[data-theme='dark'] .app-shell::before {
  opacity: 0.72;
  filter: brightness(0.72) saturate(1.1) contrast(1.05);
}

.page-content {
  flex: 1;
  width: min(100% - 3rem, 78rem);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 0 6rem;
  position: relative;
}

  --color-surface: #111111;
  --color-surface-hover: #1c1c1c;

  --color-border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

  --color-border-strong: #ffffff;
}

   Typography Badges & Micro Labels (Clean, No '//' Slashes)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.section-tag-badge {

  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface-hover);
